Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding voluntary participation in a state or national animal identification system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to voluntary participation in a state or nationalanimal identification system; and adding a new section to chapter 16.57RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.57 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Voluntary participation in any state or national animalidentification system must be obtained with informed written consent. (2) No officer, agency, or instrumentality of the state, inconjunction with the implementation of any state or national animalidentification system, may: (a) Mandate, coerce, use exclusionary tactics, support, orotherwise force participation in a state or national animalidentification system; (b) Register real property, assign real property identificationnumbers, or otherwise enroll any person in a state or national animalidentification system without the person's prior knowledge and writtenconsent; p. 1 SB 5956 (c) Withhold, from any person, indemnity based on the person'sstatus of participation in a state or national animal identificationsystem; or (d) Deny, revoke, or limit services, certificates, licenses,permits, grants, or other benefits or incentives to any person based onthe person's status of participation in a state or national animalidentification system. (3) Nothing in this section prohibits: (a) The state from establishing or participating in disease controlprograms specifically designed to address a specific disease in aspecific species of livestock; (b) Private agricultural industry organizations from establishingany source verification program; or (c) Any person from voluntarily participating in a state ornational animal identification system. (4) For the purposes of this section, "voluntary" means acting ordone without compulsion or obligation.
